name: fullstack-dev-group
description: An 18-person software/hardware delivery team as a Qoder plugin: intelligent dispatch routes each request to the right role(s), and multi-role consultation runs a team review. Each member ships a detailed agent config under agents/. Bundles 15 self-contained skills covering orchestration, full-stack engineering, ops, drawio editable diagrams, hardware/embedded, product design, QA, CI/CD, API contract, design diagrams, network topology, high-fidelity prototype, test cases, effect image generation, and interactive canvas; everything is bundled and does not depend on any globally-installed skill.
